limits: No causal reconstruction of original B03 or B03.2 failures; exact old query delay, lock holder and commit timings were not retained.
Controlled observer withholding and row locks establish mechanisms and invalid test assumptions, not proof those schedules occurred historically.
No per-server COMMIT timestamp/recurrence probability measured; true heartbeat response follows acknowledged transaction commit; expiry uses SQL database clock.
The 300 ms lease remains sensitive to real host stalls; tests do not guarantee arbitrary scheduler latency.
Global single-running-job admission can legitimately idle behind another running job; per-patient recovery cannot recover another scope. No unrestricted recovery was introduced.
No application-level system-manager, credential/network, live cloud, real-patient, clinical or release verification.
Legacy full_851_regression_verified uses exact old 510-TS count; report actual 512 TS plus 341 Python plus 25 baseline.
